title: Mickie James vs. Deonna Purrazzo
summary: Returning veteran Mickie James challenges Deonna Purrazzo’s claim to rule the Knockouts. The title change escalates their animosity into a Texas Death Match main event.

chapters.title: Mickie dethrones the Virtuosa
chapters.result: James defeats Purrazzo to win the Knockouts title.
chapters.context: The veteran interrupts Deonna’s reign, but the result makes the challenger more determined to reclaim her status.

chapters.title: Texas Death Match payoff
chapters.result: Mickie defeats Deonna to retain the championship.
chapters.context: A pinfall alone is insufficient under the stipulation. James survives the escalating violence and keeps Purrazzo down for the required count.
